title: Generated SQL preserves tenant row isolation
statement: Every generated table MUST have a non-null tenant_id referencing tenancy.tenants, a tenant index, FORCE row-level security, and policies whose USING and WITH CHECK predicates match app.tenant_id; generated DDL MUST grant only the specified platform roles and fail before table or grant changes when its target schema already exists.
rationale: The database remains the final isolation boundary even if application-level filters are wrong.

strategy.rationale: Real PostgreSQL tests apply generated DDL after platform migrations, inspect grants and RLS catalogs, assert missing-tenant and cross-tenant app-role reads and writes fail, and prove an existing target schema is untouched.
